Forged|1.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then 2 rounds of 8 bodyweight squats, 8 hip hinges, 8 push-ups, and 8 band pull-aparts. Build to the first work set in 3 steps.
Forged|1.finisher: 3 min easy walk, then stretch the muscles trained for 2 minutes.
Forged|1.notes: Rest 2 to 3 minutes between main sets. Stop each main set with 1 to 2 reps in reserve. Week 4 of every block is a deload.

Forged|2.warmup: 3 min easy walking, then begin the first movement at a low effort.
Forged|2.finisher: 5 min of slow breathing: in for 4 seconds, out for 6 seconds.
Forged|2.notes: Easy effort only. Finish feeling better than you started.

Forged|6.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then 2 rounds of 8 bodyweight squats, 8 hip hinges, 8 push-ups, and 8 band pull-aparts. Build to the first work set in 3 steps.
